paragraphs.text: The Kb'Briann Highlands is a region on Dominaria , once controlled by the Order of the Closed Fist .
It is located south-east of Benalia and west of Llanowar , at the foot of the Hurloon Mountains on the continent of Aerona . The Suder River divides the Highlands from Llanowar and the Durkwood .
The warrior clans of this region are effectively a Benalish protectorate.
